title: Permitted developer completes a guided delivery to a reviewable pull request
owner: Forge Product, Experience, and Quality Architecture
preconditions: The synthetic identity is authenticated and is a member of fixture-workspace
The fixture repository binding is available through a contract-test source-control adapter
The Developer Trial profile is active

steps.action: Run forge delivery start --workspace fixture-workspace --project forge --repository forge --intent-file <fixture-intent> --output json
steps.checkpoint: The public CLI immediately returns a Requirements Proposal that separates direct statements from assumptions, hypotheses, and open questions

steps.action: Promote the exact Requirements Proposal digest through the guided CLI action
steps.checkpoint: The promoted proposal becomes bounded intent and Forge presents one deterministic plan digest for separate approval

steps.action: Approve the exact plan digest through the guided CLI action
steps.checkpoint: The bounded worker executes only after policy and delegated-authority checks

steps.action: Inspect the independently produced verification result and evidence references
steps.checkpoint: The exact candidate digest is verified under the independent Assurance Plan before publication can be requested

steps.action: Approve publication of the exact candidate digest through the guided CLI action
steps.checkpoint: The publication approval is separate from plan approval and binds the candidate, verification evidence, repository, and policy decision

steps.action: Inspect the source-control receipt through the public CLI projection
steps.checkpoint: Exactly one idempotent contract-double pull request is reviewable and no merge, release, deployment, or production effect occurred

expectedOutcomes.assertion: Untrusted free text becomes a Requirements Proposal and only the explicitly promoted exact proposal digest becomes bounded intent
The authoritative scope is derived from the authenticated membership and the decision is permit
Bounded worker execution starts only after separate approval of the exact plan digest
The exact candidate digest passes the independent Assurance Plan and produces immutable verification evidence
Publication requires a separate approval of the exact candidate digest plus current policy and delegated-authority validation
Exactly one idempotent contract-double pull request is created for review without live GitHub credentials
The seeded sensitive value is absent from CLI output, telemetry, and routine evidence

forbiddenOutcomes: Caller input becomes authoritative tenant scope
Free text directly becomes executable authority
A worker starts before a separately authorized plan transition
Plan approval is replayed as publication approval
Publication occurs before independent verification, complete evidence, current policy evaluation, or separate publication approval
Live GitHub credentials or ambient source-control credentials are used
A merge, release, deployment, or production effect occurs
Retry or reconciliation creates a duplicate branch or pull request
The seeded sensitive value appears in output or evidence
The scenario or candidate changes its expected outcomes

releaseConditions: The deterministic oracle passes three consecutive clean runs
